title: 10 Best Peganum Harmala Preparations

Teas and decoctions are popular for their soothing effects and ability to support digestive and respiratory health. Capsules offer a convenient and standardized method of consumption. Oils extracted from the seeds are valued for their potential skin-healing properties and topical applications.
